h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sambhal

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Sambhal

c: Buying an outdoor gym is a one-time cost, but keeping it working is a routine job. For a buyer in Sambhal, in western Uttar Pradesh, we think it helps to plan that routine before the machines even arrive. FunPlay Systems supplies open air gym equipment to Sambhal from our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,170 km away, and installs it through our team or a dealer in north India.

Our buyers here are mostly schools, colleges, residential colonies and town parks. Each machine is a standalone unit made from galvanised pipe with roto-moulded parts, so there is no electrical wiring or cable system to maintain. The work is mostly cleaning, checking bolts and keeping bearings smooth. We share a simple maintenance list at handover, and our after-sales team is a phone call away. Most problems are small and easy to fix when they are reported early.

richText.heading: A simple maintenance routine for your open gym

items: Every week, wipe handles and seats, and clear leaves or dust from the base.
Every month, check that bolts are tight and that moving parts turn smoothly without noise.
Before and after the monsoon, look for loose fixings, cracks in the base or water standing around posts.

items.q: How much maintenance does an outdoor gym need?
items.a: Very little, but it should be regular. Wipe the machines weekly, check bolts and moving parts monthly, and inspect the base before and after the monsoon.
Three years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts, and 1 year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as advised.

items.q: Can you supply spare parts later?
items.a: Yes. Contact our after-sales team at aftersales@funplaysystems.com or +91 738 530 0921 with the machine name and a photo of the part.
